title.narrative: Investment Monitoring Platform and Subcontracting and Partnership Exchange Centre (SPX) in Tanzania

description.narrative: The project is implemented within the Country Framework of Support to UNDAP (2011 - 2015) The project on investment promotion will support sector players in developing coordinated efforts to mobilize domestic and FDI and enhance private sector development in the country. The activities include continued support to strengthen the capacity of the Tanzanian Investment Centre and partner institutions and their efforts in supporting investor activities as well as improving the investment environment in the country to facilitate increased investment flows. The project will be implemented in the framework of AfripaNet and will build on the activities initiated under the first phase of the One UN joint programs. The activities will focus mainly in concluding and building on the investor surveys initiated with the ongoing programs and preparation of company and project profiles using the new UNIDO methodology and efforts will be made to match make surveyed companies with transnational companies to allow their integration into the global value chains. The investment output will support the establishment of private sector systems and networks to promote linkages between supply chains with a view to promoting value adding and high productivity processes especially in agriculture and other primary sectors of the economy.
